question: Who among the following was honoured as the Internaonal Cricket Council (ICC) Men’s Cricketer of the Year for outstanding performance in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jasprit Bumrah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jasprit Bumrah** has been one of the most consistent bowlers in modern cricket, particularly in the **limited-overs format**. His pace, accuracy, and ability to deliver yorkers at crucial moments have made him a standout performer globally.
 
• In the year **2024**, he achieved significant milestones, including exceptional performances in international tournaments and bilateral series, which contributed to his recognition as the **ICC Men's Cricketer of the Year.**
 
• Bumrah's ability to perform across all formats, including **Test, ODI, and T20I cricket**, has been instrumental in India's success on various platforms. His bowling figures have often been match-winning, earning him accolades and awards worldwide.
 
• The recognition by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)** is based on players' performances throughout the year, taking into account their contributions to their team’s success and their individual achievements.
 
• Jasprit Bumrah has been lauded for his ability to handle pressure situations, especially during death overs, and his excellence in adapting to different pitches and conditions. *Hence, he was rightly honored as the ICC Men's Cricketer of the Year for 2024.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jasprit Bumrah:**

 
 
• **Age:** Born on **December 6, 1993**, Jasprit Bumrah hails from **Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India**. He is regarded as one of the most talented fast bowlers of his generation.
 
• **Specialty:** Bumrah is known for his **unorthodox bowling action** and ability to bowl accurate yorkers consistently. He is equally effective in **Test matches, ODIs, and T20Is.**
 
• **Achievements:** Bumrah has contributed significantly to India's wins in various tournaments, including the **ICC World Cup, IPL (Indian Premier League), and bilateral series.**
 
 
 
• **ICC Men's Cricketer of the Year:**
 
 
• This award is given annually by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)** to recognize the best male cricketer of the year based on their **individual performances and contributions** to the team.
 
• **Criteria:** The selection is based on players' performances in all formats of cricket during the year, including **Test matches, ODIs, T20Is, and international tournaments.**
 
• Previous winners include **Virat Kohli, Ben Stokes, and Steve Smith**, who have demonstrated exceptional skills and consistency in their respective roles.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Nominees in 2024:**

 
 
• **Rohit Sharma:** Known for his batting prowess, Rohit Sharma has been a consistent performer, particularly in ODIs and T20Is. However, his performance in **2024** did not surpass Bumrah's achievements.
 
• **Virat Kohli:** The former captain of the Indian cricket team has been a dominant force in international cricket, but his **2024 statistics** did not match Bumrah’s impact in crucial matches.
 
• **Mohammad Sami:** A talented cricketer from **India**, Sami has showcased exceptional bowling skills. However, he fell short of achieving the consistency and match-winning performances displayed by Bumrah in **2024.**
 
 
 
• **Key Characteristics of ICC Awards:**
 
 
• The awards recognize players who demonstrate **consistent performances** across all formats and their ability to contribute to their team's success.
 
• It is considered one of the most prestigious honors in the world of cricket and is keenly awaited by players and fans alike.
